About the Doctor

Dr. Vivek Pradhan
BDS — Oral & Dental Surgeon

With over 5 years of dedicated clinical experience, Dr. Vivek Pradhan specializes in comprehensive oral health — from routine care to advanced procedures like Full Mouth Rehabilitation, Dental Implants, and Smile Designing. Having trained at Government Dental College Raipur and previously worked at Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Superciality Dental Care, Mumbai, he brings both expertise and compassion to every patient.
